name: The Sheriff's Farm and Boat Landing

pages.name: The Sheriff's Farm and Boat Landing

text.content: Snohomish Valley, 40 minutes north · Ethan Montgomery's haven · Map: yes

The gravel road ends at a dark-timbered farmhouse surrounded by fields flooded with rain. There are dogs, a lot of them, and they don't bark: they watch. Behind the house, through the trees, the river glints. The man waiting for you on the porch doesn't get up from his rocking chair. His eyes are a color that isn't quite human.

Layout: main house, a barn converted into the Wolves' meeting hall, a basement with a tunnel roughly 300 meters long leading to a private boat landing on the Snohomish River, and kennels holding a dozen ghoul dogs.

Backgrounds: Haven 3 and Herd 2 (the bounty hunters, @UUID[Actor.L1oU4dlqHg8Yszon]{Montgomery's Bounty Hunters}, who live in trailers behind the barn).

Scenes: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.xWx5IoPih8fX83b1]{A1-E03 · The Sheriff Asks} (the coterie forms) and @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers} (the pack wavers). It's one of the possible targets in @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}.

Detail: Montgomery receives visitors sitting on the porch, even in the rain. If he invites someone inside, the matter is serious.
